literal_predicate_body:
def PhysicalKSAnalyticDescentIdentityOnTaylorBall
    (f : Space (Fin 3) → ℂ) (t0 : Position) (M A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ r : ℝ≥0, 0<r ∧ (r : ℝ)=min (1/1024) (7*physicalKSPointwiseRate M A)⁻¹ ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.eball (0 : Space (Fin 3)) (r : ℝ≥0∞),
      (32*(7*physicalKSPointwiseRate M A)^2)*‖fun i : Fin 3 => (ksMap q.1 i : ℂ)‖<1 →
      (7*physicalKSPointwiseRate M A)*‖fun i : Fin 3 => (q.2 i : ℂ)‖<1 →
      f ((0,t0)+q) =
        physicalKSAnalyticDescentA f t0
          (Sum.elim (fun i => (ksMap q.1 i : ℂ)) (fun i => (q.2 i : ℂ))) +
        (‖q.1‖^2 : ℝ)*physicalKSAnalyticDescentB f t0
          (Sum.elim (fun i => (ksMap q.1 i : ℂ)) (fun i => (q.2 i : ℂ)))

checks.result: The defining predicate chooses a positive NNReal r equal to min(1/1024,(7*rate)^(-1)) before all increments. For every q in the actual real product-norm eball it additionally requires D*norm(cast(KS q.Y))sup<1 and S*norm(cast(q.T))sup<1, where S=7*rate and D=32*S^2. These are explicit hypotheses, so the result is on an intersection, not on the entire Taylor ball with no further restriction. No boundary equality, global domain, or KS surjectivity is claimed.

The proof obtains the actual product-index HasSum from physicalKSTaylorSpectatorFamily_hasSum_real_ball, at the same center (0,t0) and increment q. Its upstream proof first proves absolute summability of the literal extracted coefficient family, then finite homogeneous regrouping into the original joint Taylor polynomials, then agreement of the literal complex Taylor sum with f(x+q). No reconstruction or equality-to-f premise is assumed. The existing focused reconstruction review was read instead of repeating a broad dependency audit.

The odd-zero premise in the generic theorem concerns physicalKSTaylorSpectatorFamily at Y order 2*m+1 for every spectator multiindex. The zero polynomial gives a zero evaluated term after multiplication by the same spectator monomial. hasSum_even_first_coordinate therefore restricts only the Y-degree index. Odd total Taylor degree with even Y degree remains present, including a linear spectator term.

The consumed reindex lemma preserves the same unconditional HasSum value f((0,t0)+q). The final proof reverses heven.tsum_eq to get f equal to the exact even-family tsum, then composes with the physical descent tsum equality. No use of an undefined tsum to infer convergence, conditional-series rearrangement, or changed center occurs.

physicalKSAnalyticDescentA is the homogeneous spectator sum of descentA applied to the actual even family at center (0,t0). B is the sum of descentB at even-family index n+1; the complete original index-zero B slice is proved zero before its successor reindex. The finite physical term identity uses the same inverse spinor map and balanced polynomial descent. The factor is the real scalar norm(q.Y)^2 embedded in Complex, exactly as in the target predicate.

The Taylor domain uses the maximum of Euclidean Y and Euclidean spectator norms. The descended complex polydisc radii are chosen to be the finite Pi sup norms of cast(KS q.Y) and cast(q.T), and norm_le_pi_norm gives each component bound. The proof never identifies the Euclidean norms with those coordinate sup norms.

The same actual even coefficient family supplies homogeneous degree 2*m, balanced support, and per-coefficient bound amplitude*S^(2*m)*S^(sum gamma). Amplitude nonnegativity follows from the advertised A>=1,F0>=0, and S positivity is derived from the actual rate lemma. The existing D=32*S^2 majorant controls both A and shifted B; no proposed D=2*S^2 improvement is silently used.
